# CALIFORNIA COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease Agreement made the 2025-06-01, by and between Doyle Grant [name of lessor], of 3224 Brennon Street [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessor", and Hagenes Inc [name of lessee], of 35685 Vergie Hollow [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as "Lessee", collectively referred to herein as the "Parties", agree as follows:

# 1. DESCRIPTION OF LEASED PREMISES:

The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described 7480 square feet (SF) of warehouse located at 59958 3rd Avenue [street address], State of California.

# 2. TERM OF LEASE:

The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 1 year(s) 0 month(s) commencing on the 1st day of June 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 1st day of June 2026. ("Initial Term")

# 3. BASE RENT:

The net monthly payment shall be 9993 dollars ($9993) per month. A security deposit of 5324 dollars ($5324) is required, payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month.

# 4. Options to Renew (Check one):

Lessee may not renew the Lease.

The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of __ renewal period(s) with each term being __ year(s) __ month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
